name: Neritic-Quoin
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by tectonic rift valleys. Farther poleward, past a nearby asteroid belt, the silence feels older than the soil.

Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Carpet-flora blooms all at once after each rare rain, turning whole basins scarlet overnight.
Around the exotic matter deposit, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on titanium and geothermal energy are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
